author: BernieSanders
text:
A handful of billionaires, worth $414 billion, are spending more than $150 million against California's 5% billionaire wealth tax.

They're more interested in increasing their wealth than providing healthcare to children. Disgusting.

We can and we will defeat oligarchy.
